jurisdiction_flags: France: squeeze-out at 90% of capital and voting rights (since 2019, both Euronext Paris and Euronext Growth); mandatory-offer threshold 30% (50% on Euronext Growth); a minority concert above 10% can block a squeeze-out (Keyrus 2023 precedent). Foreign-investment screening (art. R.151-3 CMF) covers cybersecurity, data hosting and health activities, so Wallix, Equasens, Cegedim, LNA Sante and Bastide would need Ministry of Economy clearance for a non-EU buyer. Payment institutions (Worldline) and investment firms (Bourse Direct, Viel/CFT, ABC arbitrage AM) sit under ACPR/AMF change-of-control approval.

challenges_to_assignment: France's in-band pool is real but almost entirely founder- or family-controlled (Linedata 75%, Neurones 59%, Cegedim 61%, Bastide 53%, Equasens 67% via Welcoop, Streamwide 67%, Keyrus 79%, Bourse Direct 83%); the only dispersed-register names in band are Infotel (founder 26%), Aubay (founder concert ~26-44%), Sidetrade (founder 36%), Wallix (~19%) and LNA Sante (family+employees ~47%). Precedent premiums in 2024-2025 were wide (Micropole ~200%, Visiativ 35.5%, Esker ~30%+), consistent with founders using cheap small-cap valuations to delist. The best vertical fits (Linedata, 74Software/SBS) are either too tightly held or above band.
